newsitem.title: USA: Dow Jones index sets fourth record high for week.
newsitem.headline: Dow Jones index sets fourth record high for week.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average jumped to its fourth record close for the week Friday as investors turned into aggressive buyers after a steep early sell-off provoked by stronger-than-expected jobs data for December.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow index rose 78.12 points to 6,703.79, surpassing Thursday's record finish of 6,625.67. But in the broader market, advancing issues led declines by a small margin on heavy volume of 548 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
